note: Node removals. No script in scripts/figma/ removes nodes — deliberately, because apply-truth-marks' own header records that deleting a design because it was never built is a call this arc already got wrong once (SH-CO-01). These are row-level duplicates inside a board, not designs, but they still need a human decision and a purpose-built applier.

rows.remove: the TEXT node and its row frame
rows.why: UX-F-06 — the ⌘K palette lists Undo twice: 'Undo' under Edit and 'Undo last action' under History (shell/modals/CommandPalette.tsx:68-88 vs :139-148), both calling composer.history.undo(). One command, one row. CONDITIONAL: if the board never drew the duplicate, this row reports NOMATCH and the defect is code-only.
rows.if-nomatch: close as code-only; the board is not the offender
